verdict.rationale: Muse's 'Goals' tab tracks tasks and lets the agent build its own tools, implying some persistent task management, and an activity log shows what it has done — suggestive of background agentic work (muse-docs-5, muse-docs-7, muse-docs-8). However, there is no explicit description of scheduling, triggers, or true unattended automation setup, and a community stress-test found the agent's control plane timing out under load, exposing reliability limits for autonomous operation (muse-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger mechanisms, documentation of automation persistence beyond a session, and independent confirmation that background tasks reliably complete without failure.
